claim: Meditation has a direct and powerful link not only to your physical state and sex drive, but also to your performance and enjoyment of sex itself, in four ways
Meditation destroys stress
Stress destroys sex drive
Stress puts the body into fight or flight mode, where things like sex drive are basically shut down and take a back seat to surviving: the state cavemen were in defending against an animal
Today the stress that puts the body into fight or flight mode is work, relationships, whatever stress weighs on us
The more stress, the more sex drive feels the effects

Meditation is without question one of the most powerful, if not the most powerful, ways to reduce stress, with countless studies and science on its effects on cortisol and stress hormones, so much proven data
To the extent we reduce stress, we improve sex drive: it's just the way our bodies work, a direct inverse relationship
Less stress, and the more you feel like having sex, the better you focus, the more present you are, the better you perform and the more you enjoy it
Less stress is better for life, and certainly for your sex life
Meditation has tremendous physical benefits on a hormonal level
With meditation, less stress means less cortisol and related stress hormones
Meditation also improves the hormones we want
One really important hormone that meditation improves is DHEA, also referred to as kind of the grandmother hormone
DHEA acts on its own, but also produces lots of downstream hormones, including testosterone for men and estrogen for women
DHEA is really closely linked to aging: levels gradually decline as we age, and doctors use it as one of the markers of sort of the true age of your body, versus your birth certificate
Higher DHEA, more youth
Meditators were studied and found to have higher DHEA levels than non-meditators by as much as 40%: a huge, drastic impact on actual hormone levels
Meditation is not just about a clear mind, concentration or presence: there are really dramatic physical benefits to mind and body
More DHEA not only increases youth, it also tends to increase sex drive, because it's converted into downstream hormones like testosterone
A lot of people don't really associate endorphins with meditation
A lot of people know endorphins are released with exercise, as in a runner's high, and make us feel incredibly good
name: Endorphins

claim: Endorphins also lead to a lot of sort of mind and physical state conducive to a positive sex drive and sex experience
name: Endorphins

claim: Meditation boosts endorphins too: one study in the Biological Psychology Journal in 1995, "so it's been a while", studied elite runners and meditators and found very similar endorphin-boosting effects
Endorphins make you feel awesome, put you more in the mood for sex and more able to enjoy it, with really powerful physiological effects on your body and mental and physical state
name: Endorphins

claim: Without question, meditation helps your ability to be present, with a focused, quiet mind
One of the other big things that kills sex drive, and especially your sex life and ability to perform and enjoy, is your ability to be present
If you're mentally distracted and your mind is always somewhere else, you're never going to be in the moment anywhere near the same way
Being mentally distracted affects sexual performance and enjoyment, and when constant throughout the day, your sex drive too

The more you get comfortable with your mind and step back, not caught up in all the clouds running around but chilling in the blue sky above them, the more you can be in the moment with sex, your sex energy and your sex life
With a more focused and quiet mind you're simply a better lover
With a more focused and quiet mind, as a lover, you last longer
With a more focused and quiet mind, as a lover, you're more attentive
With a more focused and quiet mind you enjoy sex better
With a more focused and quiet mind you're more able to control your arousal level
Meditation has really powerful benefits in so many aspects of life, and one of them is most definitely your sex life
If you haven't started a meditation practice, personally, the favorite app is Headspace, "Can't recommend that highly enough"; the first 10 days are free
Of course there's more than one way to meditate: however you do it, definitely meditate, starting Monday morning
